build_DABDETR_detector: build a DABDETR object detector with configurable random reference points and pattern embeddings
init_DABDETR_layers: initialize DABDETR transformer encoder, decoder, query embeddings, and positional encoding layers
init_DABDETR_weights: initialize DABDETR model weights with optional random reference point initialization via inverse sigmoid
run_DABDETR_pre_decoder: run the pre_decoder method to prepare query and query_pos tensors from encoder memory output
run_DABDETR_forward_decoder: run the forward_decoder method to get hidden states and reference boxes from the transformer decoder
